headline: A big move for the Colts
what_happened: D.Jones threw the ball to J.Downs for a 5-yard gain, which is enough for a first down.
who: D.Jones passed to J.Downs while being tackled by N.Williams.
why_it_matters: Since the Colts got a first down, they get a fresh set of four tries to move down the field. This increases their chances of winning by 9 percentage points while the game remains tied.
